name: golla-jev-codex
description: 골라제브 — find the pick-one moments in your work and design a Jev (TypeSafe System One) workflow: question JSON, document preview, test plan. Triggers: 골라제브, golla-jev, jev 워크플로 짜줘, jev로 자동화할 수 있을까, 제브로 뭐 할 수 있어, design a Jev workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Turn the pick-one moments in your work into a Jev workflow design
interface.longDescription: Describe a task or business idea and golla-jev finds where a person keeps choosing between options, hands those choices to Jev (TypeSafe System One), and assigns arithmetic, dates and lookups to code, sentences to templates and photo or audio reading to a multimodal model. It returns a flow, a step table, draft question JSON, an output document preview, similar public cases, failure points and a dev/holdout test plan. Includes a 108-item Korean office benchmark template and three example designs.
defaultPrompt: Where could Jev help in my team's work?
Design a Jev workflow for sorting our shared inbox.
